def rotate_list(lst, k):
    """
    Rotate the elements of the list to the right by k positions.
    """
    n = len(lst)
    k = k % n  # In case k is greater than the list length
    if n == 0 or k == 0:
        return lst
    lst[:] = lst[-k:] + lst[:-k]
    return lst
